title: Contact
layout: docs
---


The contact brick puts a contact form beside an address. You can see it in action on the [contact page](contact.html).

## Use this brick

To use this brick you only need the [contactform shortcode](docs-shortcodes-contact-form.html); everything else you write in the section becomes the address next to it:

```
{{< contactform >}}

Soetendaal 7  
1081BL Amsterdam  
The Netherlands

{{< socialbuttons >}}
```

The fields of the form are defined in `data/<lang>/contactform.yaml`. You can force the use of this block by writing:

```
---.contact
```
